summary: Tested the new public testimonial page (/t/{share_id}) and the internal send-for-approval + status reflection flow. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass, including 5 new tests for send-approval, public GET/PUT/APPROVE, edit-lock after approve, and 404 for invalid share_id. Frontend: public page renders (testimonial-page), Edit->Save persists via PUT, Approve reveals share-assets with all required data-testids (share-linkedin, download-linkedin, share-instagram, download-instagram, share-x, copy-link, share-tray), edit button hides after approve. Internal flow: login -> conversations -> story-request-approval-btn opens composer with /t/ link in composer-body, composer-send-btn closes composer and shows 'Approval request sent' toast. After public approval, reloading conversations shows Approved state and story-amplify-btn appears; the Growth Signals page also surfaces the 'Latest customer-approved testimonial' block with 'Amplify across channels'. All new endpoints and public route are wired correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: In headless/insecure contexts navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects with NotAllowedError, which surfaces as an uncaught error and triggers React dev overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors'. Wrap in try/catch and fall back to document.execCommand('copy') or a small toast-only path so end users on http/embedded contexts don't see a crash overlay.

issues: html-to-image logs SecurityError while inlining Google Fonts CSSRules (cross-origin stylesheet). Download PNG still works but console is noisy; consider self-hosting the Inter font or passing skipFonts/fontEmbedCSS options to toPng.

action_items: Handle clipboard write failure on TestimonialPage (catch NotAllowedError, use fallback + toast, don't let it become an uncaught rejection).
Optional: suppress html-to-image webfont console noise by inlining fonts or using skipFonts.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/public/testimonial/{share_id} correctly returns 400 after approval; good idempotent guard.

send-approval reuses share_id if it already exists — good. Consider also returning existing share_id on subsequent calls without changing testimonial_status back from 'approved' to 'sent' (current code always sets status='sent', which could regress an already-approved testimonial if the user clicks Send-for-approval again).
TestimonialPage.jsx copy-to-clipboard has no try/catch around navigator.clipboard.writeText — causes unhandled promise rejection in headless/insecure contexts.
html-to-image toPng call has no error handler; a font-embedding failure in a stricter CSP context could throw and leave the user with no toast/feedback.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded 2 TEST_ transcripts via API (TEST_fresh + TEST_ui_flow), analyzed via GPT-5.5, and generated share_ids 5caef1cc6308 (approved via UI) and 82fffdba92cd (approved via API). Both now visible in the demo user's conversations list.
